description.en:
Hayeon has loved her sunbae unrequitedly for a long time. However, he didn't quite see her as a woman. If you want to be technical, she is a junior from the same club and if you want to be a bit more specific, she is a girl from the same workplace. He suddenly declared his need of a partner for a quick and convenient contractual marriage. Hayeon, who couldn't contain the emotions she had held on to for a long time blurted out that she be his partner instead. With her clumsy seduction, she held on to the man’s strong back and pressed her hot lips onto his. It was a provocation from a cheeky junior. Will sunbae* be angry? Or perhaps he will laugh and call me crazy. But the words that came out of his mouth were unexpected.

---
Doyun Cha decides he isn’t looking for "true love." In fact, he wants a fake marriage. One fateful night, Hayeon, who's known him since their college club days, confesses to Doyun that she wants in on his passionless arrangement. The problem is...she has a long-time crush on him! Can she convince him to fall head over heels for her? Or will he catch wind of her hidden intentions?

description.en:
Cassia Ruberno, Countess of the Simone Empire, marries Zester Greze, a commoner war hero, at the order of emperor. After living for 10 years with no love or money, he dies of incurable disease. No, I only thought that he was dead. At the same time as his death, Cassia returns to the first day she met him, 10 years ago. However, I don't want to repeat the same life as before, so I declared a "strike." Cassia, who was blunt and knew nothing but war, was determined to live on her own without being discouraged. Strangely, Zester in this life continues to try to get into Cassia's heart. Cassia, who didn't hate Zester’s efforts and changes at the same time, said, “I think that maybe I can manage change it in this life.”

---
Although Baroness Cassia is on her deathbed, she’s relieved that it means she’s finally free from her loveless marriage to her mercenary husband, Zester. Oh, how she regrets her tireless efforts to keep his territory afloat! If only she had taken more time for herself. Her wish becomes reality when Cassia wakes up to find herself ten years back in the past. With this second chance, she’s determined to live a stress-free life. But can Cassia find the courage to rebel against Zester? Or is she doomed to repeat her nightmare of a past life?

description.fr:
Cassia Ruberno, baronne de l'Empire Simone, épouse Chester Greze, un roturier héros de guerre, sur ordre de l'Empereur... Après avoir vécu 10 ans sans amour ni argent, elle meurt d'une maladie incurable.

«Je pensais que j'étais morte, mais non.»

Le jour de sa renaissance, Cassia revient au premier jour où elle l'a rencontré, 10 ans auparavant. Cependant, elle ne souhaite pas répéter les mêmes erreurs, alors elle décida de se prélasser dans cette vie. Cassia, qui est franche et ne connaît que la guerre, est déterminée à vivre seule sans se laisser décourager! Étrangement, Chester, dans cette vie, continue à essayer d'entrer dans le cœur de Cassia. По приказу короля Кассия Руберно графиня Империи Симон выходит замуж за Зестера Гриз, простолюдина, ставшего героем войны.

Жившая в бедности, не познавшая любви, она умирает от неизлечимой болезни. Но...

Умерев, Кассия возвращается в день, когда они впервые встретились.

Однако она решает прожить свою жизнь по-другому и объявляет забастовку.

Кассия, не знавшая ничего, кроме войны, решается жить самостоятельно.

На удивление, в этот раз Зестер старается завоевать сердце Кассии.

В то же время, видя, как меняется ради неё Зестер, она думает: Пожалуй, я смогу изменить свою жизнь и прожить её счастливо.

description.vi:
Cassia Ruberno, Nữ bá tước của Đế chế Simone, kết hôn với Zester Greze – một anh hùng lính đánh thuê thường dân nghe theo lệnh của hoàng đế. Sau khi sống 10 năm mà không có tình yêu hay tiền bạc, cô ấy chết vì bệnh nan y. Cùng lúc với cái chết đó, Cassia trở lại ngày đầu tiên cô ấy gặp anh ấy, 10 năm trước. Tuy nhiên, cô ấy không muốn lặp lại cuộc sống như trước, vì vậy đã tuyên bố một “cuộc đình công”. Zester là một người thẳng thắn và chẳng biết gì ngoài chiến tranh nên cô đã quyết tâm sống một mình mà không nản chí. Kỳ lạ thay, Zester trong cuộc sống này tiếp tục cố gắng xâm nhập vào trái tim của Cassia. Cassia, người không ghét nỗ lực và thay đổi của Zester cùng một lúc, nói: “Tôi nghĩ rằng có lẽ tôi có thể xoay xở được nó trong cuộc sống này.”

description.en:
The first S-class Awakened is really a third-rate student?!

In the 21st century, the world became a 'fantasy'. In a South Korea filled with despair, S-classes have descended! The greatest of them - Witch Queen Jyo!

"Goddess Jyo... Queen Jyo... Who are you...? Who could it be?"

The true identity of the savior who has been shrouded in mystery for 10 years. Her identity? Gyung Jyo, a third-rate student, who's unable to make outgoing calls due to her mother's anger.and on the verge of being strangled and trapped in the abyss.

She was leading a peaceful and ordinary life as Korea's top unemployed person, however...

[The rankings are being updated.]
[Your current ranking has dropped to 2nd place.] 

"!?"

"I know who you are, Witch Queen."

Baek Dohyun, a regressor, appears in front of Gyung Jyo!

Will Gyung Jyo, an S-class Munchkin ranker, be able to maintain her comfortable and lazy tyrant life, as her well-rolling life turns upside down into the position of the world's savior?

---
In a world filled with towers, dungeons, and monsters, some people have awakened with special powers. While these hunters risk their lives in battle and climb the world rankings, Jio Gyeon is happy to just sit back and enjoy a simple life of leisure. But Jio has a secret—she’s the strongest hunter in the world. But when a time traveling stranger warns her of humanity’s bleak future, will Jio finally take action? And what enemies are waiting for her to reveal her true identity?

절망으로 가득했던 대한민국에 최초의 'S급'이 내려왔다!

S급의 이름은 '마술사왕 죠'
별수저 잘 잡아 천상계 랭커 1위가 되었지만,
신비주의를 고수하며 은둔 생활 중인 '죠'의 정체는?

바로 견씨 일가의 장녀이자 평범한 삼수생, 견지오.

[ 제발! 당신이 누군지 압니다. 마술사왕. ] 

그녀 앞에 갑자기 등장한 회귀자 백도현부터.

[순위가 변동합니다.]
[견지오 님의 현재 국내 순위는 2위입니다.]

네…? 뭐야, 이게. 내 1위 돌려줘요!!
별님, 나 꽃길만 걷게 해준다며….

[성약성이 당신의 뻔뻔한 인성질에 감탄합니다.]

느닷없이 내려간 헌터 랭킹 순위까지.
그녀의 평화롭던 일상에 금이 가기 시작하는데...
사람 구실하게 하려는 주변으로부터 안락하고 게으른 백수 인생을 사수해야만 한다!

톄제 원작의 <랭커를 위한 바른 생활 안내서> 완벽 비주얼화!
description.ru:
Я поймала удачу за хвост и стала охотником №1.
Как первый пробудившийся S-класс в Корее, я стала ранкером на первом месте в рейтинге Кореи и на третьем месте в мировом.

— Кстати, где и чем занимается первое место нашей страны?
— Никто не знает, его ведь не видно.
— Мистицизм зашкаливает... Он в храм ушёл?

«Я абитуриент-третьегодник. Бл***…»

Что башня, что разлом, что данж или еще что-то...
Будни, в которых я спрашивала пароль от вайфая где попало, потому что разгневанная мама отключила мне телефон.

[Рейтинг меняется]
[Текущий рейтинг Кён Чжио в Корее — 2-ой]

Что? Меня сейчас оставили на задворках?..
Сестренка Заветная звезда, ты сказала, что мой путь не будет тернистым.

[Заветная звезда восхищается вашим бесстыдством.]

«Что, ты все так же живешь как комнатный мусор».
«Вау, обязательно бить по больному?»

Начиная с красавчика-злодея, мечтающего об уничтожении мира, преступника насилия фактами...

«Помогите».
«Самоспасение, самоспасение».
«Пожалуйста! Я знаю, кто вы — Король магов».

До регрессора супер-новичка, который выглядит как главный герой современного фэнтези.
Нужно защитить эту жизнь, полную излишнего комфорта и лени, от окружающих, которые хотят заставить вас выполнять роль человека!
description.pt-br: Ela recebeu uma benção e se tornou a n°1. Ela é a primeira a despertar como rank-S na Coréia, e terceira no mundo todo. Onde está o primeiro lugar da Coréia? Ninguém sabe, e ninguém a viu. Ela é tão misteriosa- Ela é só uma estudante, ouviu isso? 'Já é a terceira vez, droga...' Torres, fendas, dungeons, o que seja, minha mãe sempre cancela meus serviços de celular, então tenho que pedir a senha do wi-fi onde quer que eu vá. [O ranking foi atualizado] [O rank nacional de Gyeon Jioh é 2º lugar] Hã...? Estou em segundo por pouco? Achei que você tinha dito que eu só percorreria caminhos floridos. [Seu contratante admira sua personalidade descarada] "Claro, você ainda vive uma vida preguiçosa." "Uau, o que deu em você para ter todo esse sarcasmo?" Desde super vilões que sonham com o fim do mundo até recrutas super novatos que se parecem com protagonistas de histórias em quadrinhos. "Por favor, me ajude." "A salvação é por conta própria. A salvação é por conta própria." "Por favor! Eu sei quem você é." Até o novato regressor que parece ser o protagonista de um romance de fantasia de sucesso. Ela deve proteger esta vida confortável e preguiçosa daqueles ao seu redor, que querem destruí-la ao querer que ela desempenhe um papel na sociedade.

description.en:
One day, I opened my eyes and found myself in… prison?!   
  
That's right - out of all the characters I could've reincarnated into, I woke up inside a 19+ rated romance novel as the villain's younger sister. As if that wasn't enough, I was locked up in the infamous Kambrakam Prison for my brother's crimes.

Deep within the very same prison lies Heinrich Dorian Von Hel, the male lead, who's rumoured to be suffering from a curse that turns him into a beast. Though he was supposed to meet the female lead and spend an *interesting* night with her right here in Kambrakam, my existence has completely changed the original plot!

What kind of future lies in store for me now that I've gotten myself tangled up between the novel's greatest villain and its protagonist?!

Что ещё хуже, я заперта в печально известной тюрьме Камбракам за преступления моего брата. В застенках той же самой тюрьмы сидит Генрих Доран фон Хель, который, по слухам, страдает от проклятия, превращающего его в зверя. В оригинальном романе он должен встретиться с девушкой и провести с ней эротическую ночь здесь в тюрьме… Но, конечно, сюжет пошёл не так, как надо, благодаря моему существованию. Какое будущее ждет меня сейчас, когда я запуталась в отношениях между величайшим злодеем романа и его главным героем?!

그리고 깨달았다.
자신이 전생에 봤던 판타지 소설 속 세계에서
소설이 시작하기도 전에 죽는 단역으로 태어났다는 것을.
아리아드네는 침착하게 생각했다.

'주인공이 회귀하면 배드 엔딩 확정이라니, 뭐 이딴 소설이 다 있어!'

결말을 바꾸려면 세계도 구하고 주인공도 구하고 동료들도 구해야 한다.
하지만, 그녀가 가장 먼저 구해야 할 사람은.

У мене в голові виникнули спогади про те, як у минулому житті батько катував мене експериментами. І я зрозуміла, що народилася другорядним персонажем, який помер ще до початку розвитку дій роману жанру “фентезі”, яку прочитала у минулому житті.
Аріадна спокійно подумала. Це провал. Провал трапився ще навіть за облаштування цього світу.
"Цей роман. Тут поганий кінець."
Кінець цього фентезі роману про чарівну країну з десятьма книгами. З провалом головного героя світ було зруйновано.
Якщо головний герой воскресне, поганий кінець забезпечений. Бувають же такі новели!
Якщо вона збирається змінити кінець, то повинна врятувати і світ, і головного героя, і його друзів.
Але людина, яку вона має врятувати насамперед...
"Візьми мене з собою, дідусю!".
Це її саму, яка мала б загинути у шістнадцятирічному віці від тортур.

In order to survive, I attempted to escape, but these cute little rascals couldn't bear to see me leave. Since they are still young, maybe I can raise them to become good people instead of bad ones. How hard could it be to raise a few villains?

“Teacher, are you leaving us behind?”

——

Masha, who had taken off his dress and wore a neat uniform, grew up as a narcissistic adult.

“Teacher, the more dangerous I am, the more likely you will not take your eyes off of me. I’m weak at the poor things.”

“I’m going to listen to whatever you want. Whatever it is, whatever it is for. Instead, the teacher should stay with me.”

Ian, who became emperor, is he truly such a foolish pushover? If so, is he hiding something else?

Oh, come on.

I think I raised them properly, but I think there’s a bit of a problem.

“I have a lot of impure things I want to do with you.”

Hello, Pope, what’s wrong with you?

HOWEVER, what if Chungah's family weren't the only ones duped by her uncle's con? Enter Millenium Adventist Church, the biggest cult in their community and one of her uncle's scam victims. description.en:
After losing her father, bratty brother, and the Elias Empire to her traitorous fiancé's schemes, Princess Regina makes a wish upon a magic ancestral stone and returns to when she was fifteen. 

With one last chance to right everything, she comes up with a plan: train her spoiled sibling to be the next ruler by becoming an even bigger brat and get Aaron Vestein, the most beautiful man in the empire, to replace her fiancé! 

But will just wits, resolve, and a new suitor be enough to change Regina's fate?
description.fr: Après l'assassinat de son père, l'empereur, et le coup d'état de son fiancé, Regina perd tout... et remonte jusqu'à ses 15 ans pour éviter ce drame. Plus question de refaire les mêmes erreurs : elle doit empêcher son petit frère de devenir un idiot capricieux et un pigeon dépensier... en devenant encore pire que lui! description.de:
Kim Si-Seub wacht eines Tages auf und stellt fest, dass sie sich in der Boys' Love Geschichte „Asterion der Abenddämmerung“ befindet. Ab sofort ist sie niemand Geringeres als Rosalite, die ältere Schwester des Hauptcharakters Asterion, und ihr steht eine Menge Drama bevor. Laut der Originalgeschichte ist es Asterions Schicksal, mit 18 Jahren zu sterben, doch Rosalite hat es sich zum Ziel gesetzt, den Lauf der Dinge zu ändern. Sie gibt ihr Bestes, um ihren kleinen Bruder zu retten, aber er stirbt immer und immer wieder – und jedes Mal, wenn Asterion stirbt, erwacht Rosalite erneut in ihrem 16-jährigen Körper. Trotzdem bleibt sie weiterhin fest entschlossen, sein Schicksal zu ändern und ihn vor wahnsinnigen Verehrern zu beschützen. description.en: One day, she woke up from bed and opened her eyes to realise she has transmigrated into the BL novel *Asterion's Starry Blue Night*. The protagonist of a crazy story who killed himself on the verge of death. I've become that protagonist's older sister... Rosalite! The issue is that if and when my brother, Asterion, dies, the system will automatically revert me back to the sixteen-year-old Rosalite! description.fr:
Un jour je me suis réveillée dans un roman, et je suis devenue Rosalite, la grande sœur d'Astérion, le héros. Je ne suis peut-être pas le personnage principal mais ce n'est pas très grave... Non, mon problème c'est que le petit frère de Rosalite est destiné à mourir à l'âge de 18 ans, ce qui est assez triste vu tout ce qu'il a dû traverser (je vous ai dit que ce roman était un BL au fait?). J'ai donc décidé de le sauver mais... peu importe les efforts que je fais, il ne cesse de mourir, et à chaque fois qu'il meurt, je retourne dans le passé, au moment où j'ai atterri dans ce fichu bouquin. Mais je n'ai pas dit mon dernier mot. Qu'ils soient beaux, riches, sexy, peu importe, le premier qui approche mon petit frère... il signe son arrêt de mort.

description.uk:
Я стала шістнадцятирічною Розалітою. Впавши з ліжка, і відкривши очі, я зрозуміла, що я в класичній, безглуздій, шаленій, але втомлюючій BL новелі "Астеріон блакитної зоряної ночі". Із всіх можливих варіантів, я стала старшою сестрою главного героя Астеріона, якому судилося закінчити життя самогубством. Я вирішила просто плити за течею історії і доплисти до фіналу, але варто було цьому статися, і мене знов повернули в тіло Розаліти. Оскільки минуле рішення було неправильне,другого разу, я вирішила виховувати братика в любові, але і на цей раз він загинув, хоча і не по свої волі. А я знов повернулась до початку. Тоді, я вирішила спробувати зовсім іншу тактику – сфокусуватись не на рятунку братика, а на самій собі. Але, і це не допомогло. Я ісекайнулася, саме тоді, коли вивчила, як користуватися магією і написала наукову дисертацію. А раз я постійно повертаюся в тіло Розаліти Роксбог, тоді обов'язково треба спробувати знайти спосіб для власної, красивої смерті.

description.en:
One day, my father gave me a boy slave. He said he saved him from the battlefield due to his good looks.

"He has a seal engraved on his heart. As long as you have this bead, he won't be able to disobey you. So you can order him to do anything."

The boy looked rather grim after hearing what he was I ordered. Ah, was I treating him too much like a dog? As my father squeezed the bead, the boy then knelt at my feet.

"Master," his red eyes flashed, illuminating his eerie gaze while smiling madly.

Why is he like this to me?! I tried my best to treat him properly!

---
Reborn as the daughter of a count she read about in a novel, Lady Valeta knows the story ends in tragedy at the hands of her lowly house pet, Reinhart. Having never wanted him in the first place, Valeta tries but fails to oust him from her house. But when Reinhart's powerful magic is awakened one day, he kills all those around her, and it is now Valeta who is at his mercy. Though the tables have turned, Reinhart can't shake his attachment for Valeta. He lets her live, but only within his grasp.

Alors que mon père pressait la perle, le garçon s’est agenouillé à mes pieds. « Maître » Ses yeux rouges ont clignoté, illuminant son regard sinistre tout en souriant follement. "자, 이제 너만 남았네. 주인님."

전생에 읽었던 소설 속 백작 영애로 환생했다. 

덕분에 아버지가 내 노예라고 데려온 한 소년에 의해 백작 가문이 몰살당하는 것도,
내가 끔찍한 죽음을 맞이한다는 것도,
이 세계의 결말도 알 수 있었다. 

그 비참한 운명을 피하기 위해 노력했지만 모두 헛수고였다. 
결국 대마법사로 각성한 그의 손에 아버지와 시종들은 모두 죽었다. 
이제 나도 죽.....을줄 알았는데?

"난 주인님이 가지고 싶었거든."

이 세계의 흑막이 나에게 집착하기 시작한다. 

.....이런 건 원작에 없었는데?

원작에서 벗어난 발레타는 조금씩 이 세계의 어두운 진실에 가까워져간다.
더러운 수작질을 벌이고 있었던 황실부터, 정체를 알 수 없는 마물들의 등장까지.

자유롭게 살고 싶었을 뿐인데 세상부터 먼저 구해야하는 상황!
과연 발레타는 원하는 삶을 찾을 수 있을까?

Одного дня мій батько подарував мені прислугу. Він сказав, що врятував його, забравши з поля бою, через гарну зовнішність. «На його серці вирізьблена печатка. Поки ти матимеш цей кулон, він не зможе протистояти тобі. Отже, ти можеш наказати йому зробити все, що завгодно.». Почувши, що його воля в моїх руках, хлопець нахмурився.
«Ох, я занадто перебільшую, поводячись із тобою — наче із собакою?», — у цей момент батько стиснув у кулак цю намистину, і хлопець упав на коліна перед моїми ногами.

description.en:
Callia Taxicate was a mere commoner until she saved the life of Simon Tereloane, the son of a duke. In return, the duke helps make her commander of the emperor's knights and she becomes a war hero. 

Though she only sees Simon as a friend, the two unexpectedly spend the night together and she ends up pregnant! description.en:
When the king offers Aerik Cladinae his own sister's hand in marriage for his meritorious deeds in battle, he didn't expect to get saddled with a limping, drooling woman like Miesa Esquillre.

Driven insane by her brother's physical and psychological torture, Miesa rolls around on the ground, spills food all over herself, and screams unintelligebly as a way of communicating. But sometimes, Aerik catches a flash of shrewd understanding behind those vacant eyes.

Is Miesa truly as mad as everyone thinks... or is she hiding something?
description.fr: Eric Chladnie, victorieux après avoir mené une longue guerre contre la principauté de Shidate, reçoit comme «récompense» par le roi jaloux de son succès, la princesse méprisée et «folle» du palais. Ce qui déclenche la colère de toute sa famille, indignée de la décision du roi. Après le mariage, son père envisage donc l'assassinat de sa belle-fille et sa mère conseille Eric de ne pas s'attacher à elle. Cependant, il choisit de la traiter avec respect et de prendre soin d'elle, en dépit de son attitude enfantine. Mais, très vite il comprend que la princesse n'est pas folle, ni simple d'esprit. Il va alors essayer de dévoiler la raison de sa comédie, et ce que cache réellement la famille royale.
description.id: Eric Chladnier, penerus Kerajaan Chladnier mendapatkan Miesa Esquilir, putri Kerajaan Esquilir yang terkenal "spesial" sebagai hadiah kemenangannya memimpin perang. Menghadapi Miesa dengan penuh kesabaran dan pengertian, akankah Eric menemukan titik temu cinta kasih mereka?
description.ko:
“그래, 눈에 넣어도 아프지 않은 내 동생을 주지.”  
시다테 공국과의 오랜 전쟁을 승리로 이끈 에이릭 클라드니에,  
승전 포상으로 백치 왕녀와의 결혼을 명 받게 되었다. 

결혼식 후, 아내가 된 왕녀와 함께 저택으로 돌아온 에이릭.  
왕녀의 기상천외한 행동에 아버지는 그녀를 죽이려하고 어머니는 에이릭에게 마음을 주지 말라고 조언한다.  
오직 에이릭만이 어린 아이같은 그녀를 아내로써 존중하며 보살피는데... 

왕 앞에서 그가 한 적도 없는 행위를 천역덕스럽게 지어내어 흉내내는 저 여자는 대체 누구란 말인가.
description.pl: „Bardzo dobrze. Ofiaruję ci moją siostrę, cenniejszą mi niż ktokolwiek”. Eric Cladnier, który poprowadził długą wojnę do zwycięstwa nad Księstwem Shidate, w nagrodę za swój triumf otrzymał przywilej poślubienia głupiej księżniczki. Po ceremonii ślubnej Eric wrócił do rezydencji z świeżo poślubioną księżniczką. Pośród ekscentrycznego zachowania księżniczki jego ojciec próbuje ją zabić, a matka radzi mu, aby nie oddawał jej serca. Tylko on, traktując ją jak dziecko, szanuje i ceni ją jak swoją żonę. Kim jednak jest ta kobieta, która przed cesarzem podszywa się pod czyny, których nigdy nie dokonała i postępuje pobożnie?
description.th: เอริค คราวด์เนีย ผู้สืบทอดอนาคตไกลของตระกูล ถูกสั่งให้แต่งงานกับเจ้าหญิงโดยที่เขาเองก็ยังไม่ทันตั้งตัว "อยู่ ๆ ฉันก็ต้องกลายเป็นสายลับขององค์ราชางั้นเหรอ?" เอริคได้พบกับหญิงสาวซึ่งน่าจะเป็นจุดอ่อนของครอบครัวนี้ แต่นางดันเป็นเจ้าหญิงซื่อบื้อที่ทำให้ทุกคนต้องตกใจกับพฤติกรรมที่แย่ยิ่งกว่าเด็กตัวเล็ก ๆ เสียอีก แต่ว่า ผู้หญิงอีกคนหนึ่งที่แต่งหน้าออกมาได้อย่างเป็นธรรมชาติและก็ทำสิ่งต่าง ๆ ที่เขาไม่เคยทำมาก่อน คือใครกันแน่นะ?
description.zh:
在这偌大的皇宫之中，
愚笨不过是保命伪装
“好，那就将我视为掌上明珠的妹妹许配给他吧。”埃里克·克拉德尼尔在与西塔泰公国的漫长战争中凯旋归来，被国王指婚痴傻王女作为战胜的奖赏。看到王女的痴傻行为后，父亲想杀了她，而母亲则劝告埃里克不要对她动感情，只有埃里克尊重并照顾这个像孩子一般的妻子。可在国王面前编造他从未做过的行为，并进行模仿的那个女人又是谁呢？
description.pt-br: "Muito bem. Vou lhe dar minha amada irmã, a quem estimo muito." Eric Chladnie, que liderou a longa guerra até a vitória contra o Principado de Shidate, recebeu o mandato para se casar com uma princesa tola como recompensa por seu triunfo. Após a cerimônia de casamento, Eric voltou para a mansão com a princesa recém-casada. Em meio ao comportamento excêntrico da princesa, seu pai tenta matá-la e sua mãe aconselha a não entregar seu coração. Só ele, tratando-a como uma criança, a respeita e cuida dela como sua esposa. Porém, quem é essa mulher que, diante do rei, personifica atos que nunca praticou e age piedosamente?
description.zh-hk: 艾里克·克利德尼埃在與錫塔特公國的戰爭中，帶領王國取得了勝利，獎賞則是與白痴王女結婚。 婚禮結束後，艾里克帶著王女回到自家宅邸，面對王女的怪異行為，父親打算殺了她，母親則叫艾里克不要對她動心。 只有艾里克尊重並照顧像孩子一般的王女…

My family and my husband killed me. Because of the inheritance. Returning to the past, I made up my mind.

“I have to protect my life and my inheritance.”

Grand Duke Lapireon of the cursed family. I offered him, who was not interested in property and women, a one year contract marriage. Now, all we have to do is get a divorce…

“Lady, do you think you can leave me now?”

My husband is weird.

“Would you like a land or a mine? Or an empire?”

“Sasha, did Theo do something wrong?”

“Mom, don’t leave me.”

“Sister… I can’t live without you.”

Even my in-laws began to obsess over me.

(Taken from NU)

description.en: During the era of space exploration, mankind is at war against monsters of unknown origin. The battle is grim, and the future looks bleak. Amidst the chaos, mankind plays their last hand. It's time for the Knights to step into the fray and turn the tide of this war.

Scarlett was a happy girl. With beautiful looks, a wealthy family, and even a kind fiancé, Scarlett was expected to be the most beautiful bride in the world. But on the morning of her wedding day, the pure-white bride was killed by someone. When she opened her eyes again, everything was different.   
  
"I've told you many times before. It's because I'm Scarlett Antwerp!"   
  
"I'm sorry, but the Esteemed Daughter of the Count, Lady Entwerp, is already dead."   
  
Waking up in a strange place, Scarlett could not understand what had happened to her. Why couldn't anyone recognize her? Why was her fiancé standing next to another woman? Why was she Vivian instead of Scarlett, the Esteemed Daughter of the Count? Why was the one next to her not her fiancé Edward, but Alexis, the police chief? Scarlett swore that she'd get her fiancé back and get revenge on the one who killed her.

description.fr:
Kim Jun-Woo, le premier chasseur de génie de rang SSS au monde.

Il est un utilisateur incroyable de capacité, mais sa personnalité horrible conduit à des problèmes avec sa réputation.

Au milieu de ses problèmes, il a été attaqué et tué par un groupe non identifié.

Quand il a ouvert les yeux, il était retourné dans le passé, il y a 10 ans.

Bien qu’il essaie de redevenir un chasseur et d’élever son rang, ses compétences ont toutes été scellées par le karma de sa vie antérieure.

Pour le libérer, il doit travailler comme « nettoyeur de donjon », un métier réputé pour être extrêmement dur dans cette industrie !

Mais ce nettoyeur, il est différent !

하지만 이 청소부, 남다르다!
몬스터는 물론이거니와, 골깝떠는 헌터, 자리만 차지하는 낙하산 상사, 심지어 동료가 될 사람까지
모든 걸 청소할 기세로 깽판을 치는데...

현직 헌터보다 더 강한 전직 헌터의 망나니식 청소가 시작된다!
description.pt-br:
Kim Jun-woo, o primeiro caçador genial de rank SSS.

Ele é um incrível usuário de habilidades, mas sua personalidade horrível trás problemas para sua reputação.

No meio de seus problemas, ele foi atacado e morto por um grupo não identificado. E quando abriu os olhos, havia retornado 10 anos para seu passado.

Para conseguir libertar suas habilidades, ele precisa trabalhar como um “Limpador de Dungeons”, que tem a fama de ser incrivelmente difícil! Mas esse faxineiro, ele é diferente!

description.en:
Finally, it was their first night.

Leticia whispered, leaning her forehead against his chest, "As expected, is it too far? Should I get closer?"

Dietrian barely swallowed a groan. His hand grasping Leticia's shoulder was shaking with a sweet faze, but she didn't notice.

"I know that you're uncomfortable. But please bear with me until my mother comes."

Dietrian hated Leticia. It was natural as Leticia's mother killed his family. She had never doubted the fact. So she didn't know, how badly his face was distorted by her words.

"You just have to put up with me for half a year. Then, I will divorce you as you wish."

At the word 'divorce,' he grit his teeth.

---
Despite being the daughter of the Holy Empire’s most revered divine leader, Leticia is rumored to be a ruthless, bloodthirsty tyrant. The thing is… none of the rumors are true! After years of living as her vindictive mother’s scapegoat, Leticia is ultimately cursed to die if she doesn’t kill her beloved husband, King Ditrian, with her own two hands. But when the clock miraculously resets to mere days before their wedding, she gets a second chance to save not only Ditrian, but his entire kingdom. This time, will the world recognize the real Leticia before it’s too late, or is history doomed to repeat itself?

세준은 경찰에게 말해보지만 수사에 별 진척이 없자

그렇게 3개월, 운동을 배우고 살을 뺀 세준은 일진들을 쓰러뜨려가며

description.en:
Siana was a princess of a small kingdom. Until the imperial army attacked…

Just before her neck was about to be cut by the cruel prince, Siana screamed, “Please spare me!”

Towards the prince with blood staining his beautiful face, Siana pleaded with a desperate voice.

“I have many skills learned in the palace. Wouldn’t I be useful as a maid?”

And so, Siana became a probationary maid of the palace. But surprisingly, the job suited her temperament?! When she swept the floors, the corridors became clean, when she kneaded dough, sweet cookies were baked, when she did laundry, the bedding became white and fragrant! She only did her best as a maid, but gradually, the royal family began to warm up to Siana.

“The tea you brewed is always the best.”

“The dress you made? Truly beautiful.”

“I want you to educate the prince.”

But she never thought of capturing this man’s heart…

“I feel the same.”

“…”

“I can’t live without you, Siana,” hearing the tender voice of the prince, Siana tightly closed her eyes.

Look, Your Highness. I just want to live as an ordinary maid!

When trouble comes knocking, Riley is forced to make a decision — take up the sword, or let his loved ones die. Will the “Lazy Sword” finally bloom into the legendary swordmaster he was always destined to become?

description.en:
Sirens… a name derived from an ancient creature, used to describe those who could charm, lure, control, and heal others by singing. Years ago, a siren named Sophia was kidnapped by Count Cortez as his prized siren, and a girl named Aria was born soon after as their daughter. Subjected to live the life of a siren, Aria had experienced, seen, and heard many horrific things. Others would do anything to hear her sing, to the point of insanity. The emperor, who grew obsessed with her, broke her legs and locked her in a bird cage deep within the imperial palace to hide her and keep her to himself. Broken beyond repair, Aria resigned herself to death, when suddenly–  
  
The Devil Archduke, Lloyd Cardenis Valentine, arrived and whispered, "Should I kill everyone here? If you need me, just call me. Your song will always reach me, wherever you are."  
  
In the end, Aria called the devil, bringing death to all those present, except for herself.  
"Let's fall down to Hell together."  
And with that, Aria breathed her last and died… only to return back to her 10 year old self.  
  
Now that she has a second chance at her life, Aria is determined to change her fate, as well as the cruel future of her savior, Archduke Valentine. She proposes a contract marriage to him, with a divorce planned 10 years later, but he has other plans…

I’m a witch that’s over 300 years old, but I died at the hands of a human I’d trusted. I thought I’d be stuck in the spiritual world forever, but I reincarnated as the princess of a violent and bloody imperial family, where siblings would murder each other for the throne.

“You. Become my vassal.”

“I picked this up for you. You can decide to eat it or throw it away.”  
“Can’t you touch me just once? If I tell others that you stroked my head, they would be so jealous.”

…Will I be able to sit on the throne?

description.pl: Została statystką, która zginęła z powodu swojego nędznego narzeczonego. Udało jej się zaprzyjaźnić z bohaterką, aby odwrócić bieg wydarzeń. "Przykro mi, Ciela. Ale wciąż jesteśmy przyjaciółmi, prawda?". Bohaterka miała romans z moim narzeczonym. Tak, śmiało i weź to gówno. "Czy chciałbyś być w związku z kimś, kto miał romans z moim narzeczonym, Wasza Wysokość?". Ponieważ zdecydowałam się na główną rolę męską. Odkąd zerwałam zaręczyny, mogę zacząć zdobywać główną rolę męską po wyjściu z oryginalnej historii i postanowiłam cieszyć się szczęśliwym życiem. Po pewnym czasie rozeszły się plotki, że byłam kochanką Księcia Koronnego i zgarniałam pieniądze. Pojawiła się też kolejna wiadomość, że oboje zerwali. "Ciela, myliłam się. Czy nadal możemy być przyjaciółmi?" "Ciela... byłem głupi. Jesteś jedyną osobą, którą kocham. Ty też mnie kochasz, prawda? Więc zacznijmy od nowa." Co? Czy oni oboje postradali zmysły? Odrzucając ich, uniosłam kąciki ust. "Nie rozśmieszaj mnie. Wynoś się stąd."
description.ru:
Я очутилась на месте второстепенного персонажа, который должен умереть по вине придурка-жениха.
Чтобы переписать оригинальную историю, я стала лучшей подругой главной героини, у которой был роман с моим женихом...

— Мне жаль, Сиела. Но мы всё ещё друзья, верно?

Да, давай, забирай себе этот мусор. Потому что я заполучу главного героя.

Она смогла расторгнуть помолвку и сблизиться с главным героем, избежав повторения оригинального сюжета. Осталось лишь наслаждаться счастливой жизнью.
Но вскоре после этого поползли слухи, что она стала любовницей принца и неплохо наварилась на этом, а ещё новости о том, что те двое расстались.

— Сиела, я была неправа. Мы всё ещё друзья, ведь так?
— Сиела... Это было так глупо с моей стороны. Ведь я люблю только тебя одну. Ты тоже любишь меня, не так ли? Давай начнём сначала.

Что за чёрт? Вы с ума посходили?

— Не смешите меня и валите отсюда!

Savaş romanında, ne kan ne de gözyaşı dökmüş bir hainin kız kardeşi olarak yeniden doğmuştu.  
Erkek kardeşim olarak davranan cani, savaşı kaybettikten sonra, erkek liderliğinden uzakta gizlenirdi.  
Bu yüzden yapmam gereken tek şey ileride kaybolana kadar kız kardeşiymiş gibi davranmak.  
Ya da düşündüm de…  
  
''Elindeki ne? Erkek liderin kellesi olduğunu söyleme sakın!..''  
Erkek kardeşim savaşı kazanmıştı.  
  
''O bavul da ne?''  
  
''Ha?''  
  
Dietrich'in savaşı terk eder etmez hazırladığım bavulu kavrayan parmakları sıkılaştı.  
  
''Bu nedir, diye sordum sana.''  
  
''B-Bu bir gezi bavulu, abi.''  
  
''Gezmek mi istiyorsun? Tek başına?''  
  
Dietrich'in koyu gözleri gürültüyle parladı.  
Yakın zamanda savaştan galip dönmüşken, tabii ki kana susamış gibi kokuyordu.  
  
''Ve beni arkada mı bırakacaksın?''

I decided to try to avoid that by leaving the capital and living peacefully in the countryside, however, my dad requested that I come back to the capital because there was a huge mess going: it was reported that the royal heir who was believed to have died 7 years ago is actually alive! The little prince also just so happens to be the nephew of the male lead, who is now looking for him!! In the original story, the female lead was supposed to find him so she could have the opportunity to meet the male lead, but what will happen to my peaceful life now that the original flow of the story seems to be changing?!!

Чтобы избежать этого, я отправилась жить в далёкую провинцию, но отец позвал меня в столицу, в которой все были чем-то взволнованы. Поиски наследного принца…

Buna dahil olmak istemedim ama ne yazık ki başkente giderken kayıp kraliyet varisi olan ve şimdi bana aşırı derecede bağlı olan zavallı bir çocuğa rastladım.

There is no romance in store for me, and it absolutely horrifies me to think that my family is destined to drown in debt!

I planned on becoming a civil servant, enjoying a life of wealth and honor that I was unable to attain in my previous life but… why are the guys behaving out of character? Why are you blushing in front of me? Why do you keep giving me food?

“Can you Imagine Shushu being shy when looking at someone?”

description.en:
***"To me, he's my destiny. To him, I'm just a girl he knows."***  
  
A young woman grieves the unexpected death of her neighbor and former high school classmate, as she liked him ever since she met him. She had never gathered the courage to confess, and she wasted whatever little chance she had with him.  
  
During a drunken bus ride with a man she's been meeting from time to time, himself a former schoolmate, the bus gets into an accident, and both her and the man find themselves transported 10 years in the past.  
  
Together they agree not to tamper with the past because he staunchly refuses to change his already idyllic future, but she progressively starts seeing this as a second chance to save the life of the boy she loves.

Juntos juran no alterar el pasado porque el hombre se rehusa vehementemente a cambiar su futuro que ya es de ensueño, pero ella empieza a ver esto como una segunda oportunidad de salvar la vida del muchacho que le gusta.

description.en:
After dying in an accident, I was reincarnated in an otome game …as a **crow**! I can't believe that I am a crow! Not an extra character, but a crow! When I was looking for a person near me… the first person who appeared was the Crown Prince.

"How could you be so lovely, Reinel?"

"Cawk cawk, cawk! (Take me with you and raise me!)"

The Crown Prince, Kamut, gave me a name and treated me with love. I'm just a crow anyway, there'd be no problem if I liked him or if my heart fluttered for him. There was no problem until…

"Hello, Reinel?"

"What is happening to me all of a sudden?"

---
Life is about survival of the fittest... But what do you do when you're reborn as a crow? Find someone big and strong to take you in, of course! After saving Prince Camute's life, Rainelle is brought to the imperial palace to live as his pet. However, just as she believes she's set to live a life of comfort, she finds herself caught at the center of a dangerous power struggle between Prince Camute and his brother. Now that her survival depends on his, will Rainelle find a way to help her prince?

description.en:
Forbidden romance on the high seas!
It was all smooth sailing for Lil Schweiz, a famous pirate captain, until some shocking news almost threw her overboard. The notorious Admiral Retiro, known for scalping and feeding his pirate captives to flesh-eating fish, is on his way... And he's coming for one thing only.
description.id: Asmara terlarang di laut lepas! Semuanya berjalan mulus bagi Lil Schweiz, seorang kapten bajak laut yang terkenal, sampai beberapa berita mengejutkan hampir membuatnya terlempar ke laut. Laksamana Retiro yang terkenal kejam, dikenal karena suka menguliti dan memberi makan tawanan bajak lautnya kepada ikan pemakan daging, sedang dalam perjalanan... Dan dia datang hanya untuk satu hal.
description.ko:
남부 바다에서 유명세를 날리는 해적 ‘릴 셰이즈’
순탄한 항해 중이던 그녀에게 청천벽력 같은 소리가 떨어진다.

“제독이 온다고 하오.”

이 더운 날씨에 등골이 다 서늘했다. 릴은 눈에서 손을 떼고 알랭을 올려다보았다.
못 들은 게 아니지만 다시 한 번 확인하고 싶었다.

“누구?”
“반도의 제독! 그 미친놈! 아, 레티로 제독 말이요!”

잡은 해적의 머리 가죽을 벗긴다느니, 식인 물고기 밥으로 던져 준다느니.
온갖 해괴한 악명은 다 달고 다니는 그 ‘제독’이 온다고?
최대한 엮이지 말아야 한다! 오기 전에 뜨자!

그런 릴도 모르는 한 가지.

[너, 에든지 개불인지는 나, 릴에게 세스브롱 예법에 따라 매우 정중하고도 고상하게 처벌받았음을 알린다.]

이미, 엮였다!

“이 재미난 연극에 내가 맡을 역할이 있어 다행이군.”

에드는 정수리에 드리워진, 거대한 돛을 투과하는 태양빛을 짧게 올려보았다.
머리 위 하늘이 곧 수 개의 상아빛으로 덮여갔다.

“선의 노릇이라니, 아주 즐겁겠어.”


해적선장과 해군제독의 해양 로맨스 판타지!
송윤작가의 <북북서로 진로를 돌려라>가 웹툰으로 돌아왔다!

title.en: I Am the Male Lead's Ex-Girlfriend (Promo)

description.en:
I am the villainess in a harem novel. My role as "Erika" is to be an evil ex-girlfriend. I don't want to be a dumb villainess, so I broke up with the male-lead first… But after 3 years, Leo came back to me.   
  
"I can't live without you. I still like you…"  
  
I'm not the girl you should be obsessed with?! The second leads also came to me.  
  
"I like it when you're next to me…"   
  
I'm just a supporting villainess, yet why are all these men confessing to me?! Who should I choose?

At the same time, world is now covered with monsters and people who starts getting super powers. The world is starting to change and evolve. When Tae Min Park realizes something beyond, he does everything he can to find the truth of freedom.
description.it:
In un lontano futuro, un meteorite sta per schiantarsi contro la Terra, ma improvvisamente scompare nel momento in cui sta per atterrare. Nel presente, il mondo ora é invaso da mostri e le persone iniziano a ottenere   
dei superpoteri. Il mondo sta iniziando a cambiare ed evolversi. Quando Tae Min Park realizza che c'è qualcos'altro sotto, fa tutto il possibile per scovare la verità.

description.en:
[The Tower of Trials has selected all suitable candidates from Earth.  Please select your difficulty.]

Seong-yun Han was just a boy when his parents were killed by monsters unleashed during a mysterious calamity called the “Dungeon Break.”

Seven years later, Seong-yun is devastated to find that his grinding efforts to become a Hunter, fierce warriors who seek out and destroy monsters, are entirely in vain, as his fighting attributes have not increased at all.

Seong-yun’s world flips on a dime when he accepts an invitation to join the Tower of Trials, an otherworldly realm where challengers must overcome trials that pit them against monsters and humans alike!
description.ko:
평생 헌터가 되지 못할 줄 알았다.
기회 같은 것은 찾아오지 않을 거라 여겼다.
하지만 아니었다.

「‘시련의 탑’이 지구 차원의 모든 적합자를 선별해냈습니다.」

「난이도를 선택해주십시오.」

「선택하는 난이도에 따라서 보상도 커집니다.」

이제 내게도 기회가 주어졌다.
그것도 아주 특별한.

title.en: I Am the Precious Daughter of the Greatest Villain in the Fantasy World (Promo)

description.en:
I thought I was reincarnated as the daughter of a wealthy family, but it turns out I was born as the child of the greatest villain in the fantasy world of martial arts. My father doesn't care about me, I'm ostracized by the others, and I'll eventually be murdered as a side antagonist by the male lead, after suffering from my one-sided love.  
  
Even worse, this is a world where the weak are the prey of the strong, conceited antagonists.  
  
So, before it's late, I need to learn martial arts and escape!  
  
However, there was a fatal flaw in my plan…  
  
Because of my notorious father, there were too many people who sought to end my life.  
  
"Wahhh! Dadda! (Daddy!)"  
  
…Will I ever be able to escape safely?  
  
[One-shot Promo Manhwa for the Novel]

altTitles.zh: 女儿的超能力是把我变帅！

description.en: Graduate student Kim Jihoon's life is turned upside-down when the long-lost daughter he didn't know he had turns up on his doorstep. After he takes in his daughter Chaerin at her mother's request, Jihoon's life takes a surprising turn for the better. Things start going his way at school, and even his eyesight improves. Although parenting a precocious 7-year-old is a handful, Jihoon loves his little girl, and life is better than ever. It's almost as if there's some magical force at work...
